exposure: Nulliparous patients with term, singleton, vertex-presenting fetuses
cohort: 58,328 patients who delivered viable, liveborn, singleton newborns at a large academic hospital between 2000 and 2012
finding: Patients delivered by obstetricians with low delivery volume are at significantly increased risk for cesarean delivery, even after controlling for patient and obstetrician characteristics.
mod_finding: Patients delivered by obstetricians with low delivery volume were at significantly increased risk for cesarean delivery.
